correctness.rationale: The explicit source graph has exactly 18 edges; exhaustive reconstruction yields face vector (12,48,74,36), exactly 18 matching-triple six-vertex induced subgraphs, and an induced octahedral sphere on each. The final package includes and verifies 18 independent 72-pair collapse certificates, checking the current unique strict coface and exact final face equality. With elementary-collapse topology this proves S² and all integral homology claims. The graph triangle/spoke argument proves Aut(D)=D6, and signed Lefschetz traces for all 12 permutations prove the integral orientation character. Pure dimension three with H2 nonzero disproves Cohen–Macaulayness.

value.rationale: The Dürer graph is a canonical planar cubic well-covered example. The theorem identifies and classifies all minimal six-vertex induced flag sphere cores, proving that each supports an inclusion-preserving simple-homotopy reduction; their two automorphism orbits and signed integral homology character explain extra structure. This is substantially more informative than a small Betti-number calculation and exhibits motivated pure non-Cohen–Macaulay behavior.
